caption: The drawing displays a rectangular mirror with an ornate gold frame. The frame is embellished with a decorative border that features a pattern of small flowers or rosettes at each corner. At the top of the frame, there is a prominent oval medallion, encircled by a twisted wreath, which depicts a shield with an eagle and other heraldic elements; above the medallion sits a detailed sculpted eagle with outspread wings. Twisted gold ropes or garlands form loops that extend from the medallion along the top and sides of the frame and are also present at the bottom corners, converging at an oval cartouche or plaque centered at the bottom. The mirror itself has a blue-grey tinted reflection, indicating subtle shading to suggest glass. The entire composition is set against a light beige or off-white background, and the detailed frame fills most of the picture space.
title: Mirror
